title: How NASA Hauled a Space Shuttle Through City Streets
description: After flying nearly 123 million miles in space, Space Shuttle Endeavour took its slowest journey yet: a 68-hour crawl through the streets of Los Angeles.

beats.text: Endeavour had already flown nearly 123 million space miles.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Endeavour orbiting Earth during a space mission

beats.text: It was built from spare parts left behind by other orbiters.

beats.text: But its 12-mile journey through Los Angeles took 68 hours.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Endeavour moving past crowds on Los Angeles streets, 2012
queries: Space Shuttle Endeavour Los Angeles transport

beats.text: Crews cut down over 400 trees to clear the wide wings.

queries: Space Shuttle Endeavour tree removal Los Angeles

beats.text: Workers shut off power lines and pulled down traffic lights.
beats.visual: Utility workers disconnecting power lines for space shuttle passage
queries: Space Shuttle Endeavour utility power lines

beats.text: The spacecraft squeezed past apartment buildings with inches of clearance.

beats.text: Top speed for the entire trip was just two miles per hour.
